security_boundaries: system-level publish/list paths are explicit GLOBAL_SHARED semantics
tenant_boundaries: enqueue stores caller org; throttled merge now org/NULL scoped; listSince/listLatest viewer org + global only

findings.evidence: enqueueThrottled matched eventType/entityId/status/time without orgId, so same-shaped entity IDs in different orgs could merge pending events.
findings.impact: One tenant could overwrite another tenant pending event payload and metadata.
findings.fix: Added NULL-org-aware org condition and cross-tenant regression.

findings.evidence: enqueueThrottled accepted opts.executor but always used this.db for merge and insert.
findings.impact: A compensating throttled event on a failed request transaction may roll back if callers assume executor semantics.
findings.fix: Throttled UPDATE now uses opts.executor with the same fallback contract as enqueue; outbox, RLS and golden tests pass.

entry_points: outbox throttle and sequence contract suite
tenant_boundaries: org1 merge and org2 isolation regression

findings.evidence: Throttle tests lacked a same-entity different-org case.
findings.fix: Added org2 pending insertion regression and aligned existing seed filter with org1.
